description: This source file provides a wrapper around the fetch API for HTTP requests in a React environment, with support for timeouts, JSON handling, error normalization, and configuration-based API base URL.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Builds a full URL from a relative path and the configured API base.

methods.name: parseResponse(resp)
methods.description: Normalizes the fetch response, attempting to parse JSON or fallback to text.

methods.name: httpRequest(path, { method = 'GET', headers = {}, body, timeoutMs = 12000, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs a network request with support for timeout and JSON handling.

methods.name: httpGet(path, { headers = {}, timeoutMs, signal } = {})
methods.description: Convenience helper for GET requests that returns parsed data.

methods.name: httpPost(path, body, { headers = {}, timeoutMs, signal } = {})
methods.description: Convenience helper for POST requests sending JSON data.

methods.name: isMockMode()
methods.description: Checks whether the app should run in mock mode (no API base configured).
